subject.title: First-run experience — default onboarding into the local gateway

question: Should the companion app’s golden-path “local gateway” be the current WSL-hosted gateway or a gateway hosted directly on Windows?
rationale: Current main defaults to a WSL installation, while the open collaborator-authored epic explicitly names a local Windows gateway; this choice determines whether the issue is nearly complete or still requires substantial runtime and setup work.

options.title: Windows-hosted gateway
options.body: Keep this issue open as the end-to-end acceptance target for a gateway hosted directly on Windows.

options.title: WSL-hosted gateway
options.body: Declare the current WSL flow the intended local golden path and update the epic and sibling acceptance criteria to match.

recommendation.title: Windows-hosted gateway
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the end-to-end acceptance target for a gateway hosted directly on Windows.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current onboarding redesign and is the strongest traced owner for reconciling its implementation scope with the roadmap language.
